content: The sentence containing target words is denoted as context sentence. For each target word, we extract glosses of all $N$ possible senses (here $N=4$) of the target word (research) in WordNet to obtain the gloss sentence. [CLS] and [SEP] marks are added to the context-gloss pairs to make it suitable for the input of BERT model. A similar idea is also used in aspect-based sentiment analysis BIBREF16.
